decision.reason: Robot 0 appears to support the outer edge; robot 1 supports the edge nearest the garment-side raised hand. Historical continuity suggests these are hem grips, not sleeve cuffs. Lift together about 2 cm to check each grip’s support and clarify the hand–rim relationship before advancing.

Cloth appears to have followed both grips: robot 0 supports the outer edge and robot 1 the hand-side edge. The broad opening still appears to be the hem. Tilt both wrists slightly downward to expose the hanging sleeve region beside the same raised hand before advancing.

Robot 0 retains apparent outer-hem support; robot 1 retains the hand-side edge. Two adjustments have not revealed a distinct cuff beside the same raised hand. Withdraw slightly together and raise robot 1’s edge to unfold the garment and improve the view before further approach.

Robot 0 retains apparent outer-edge support but its base barely retreated; robot 1 supports the elevated hand-side edge. Retract robot 0’s arm farther than robot 1’s to turn the garment obliquely and expose the hanging side seam. A sleeve opening beside the same raised hand remains unconfirmed.

Robot 0 supports the outer hem; robot 1 appears to support the hand-side hem near its lift limit. Lower robot 0’s edge and roll both wrists together to expose the garment’s side contour beside the same raised hand. A sleeve cuff remains unconfirmed, so do not advance.

Robot 0 retains apparent outer support; robot 1 retains the raised hand-side edge. Tilting exposed more hem but no distinct cuff. Turn both wrists outward, slightly more on robot 1, to move its grip away from the same target hand and reveal the occluded hand–cloth boundary.

Robot 0 supports the lower outer hem; robot 1 supports the hand-side hem. The target hand appears just left of robot 1’s grip, without a visible cuff around it. Raise robot 0 and pitch both wrists upward to level the hem and expose the hanging sleeve region, preserving forward clearance.

Cloth rose with both grips. Robot 0 is still rising toward robot 1’s height, and both wrists are still pitching upward. Maintain both grips and let those motions settle before reassessing the hanging sleeve region beside the same hand; no sleeve passage is visible.

Robot 0 supports the outer hem and robot 1 the hand-side hem. The blue side projection below robot 1 is a cuff candidate, distinct from the broad yellow hem but still uncertain. Shift both slightly left to align it with the same raised hand, then inspect before forward insertion.

Robot 0 and robot 1 still appear to support their respective hem edges. Lateral alignment did not reveal a cuff around the target hand. Retract both arms together to gain clearance for a supported reorientation; further insertion remains unjustified by the visible opening.

Robot 0 supports the outer edge and robot 1 the nearer edge; cloth followed both during withdrawal. Begin shifting together toward the visible central tabletop, maintaining height and separation, to establish table support for reorientation. Sleeve passage remains unconfirmed.
